title: Understanding Model Variance
text: Model variance refers to how much the model's predictions change when it is trained on different datasets. Reducing variance can lead to more stable predictions.

title: Feature Transformation
text: Transforming features can help in reducing model variance. Consider how different transformations might affect the spread and distribution of the data.

title: Floor Function
text: The floor function, $$\operatorname{floor}\left(\frac{x}{5}\right)$$, rounds down the value of $$\frac{x}{5}$$ to the nearest integer. This can reduce the number of unique values in the dataset, potentially reducing variance.

title: Applying the Floor Function
text: Consider how applying the floor function to the age variable might affect the model's variance. Would it lead to fewer unique values and thus potentially reduce variance?
